## Activity

During May 2026, Harbour Eye Clinic recorded 450 captures. This level of activity represents the images submitted for review during the month. The figure provides the basis for the image-quality and grading measures reported below. Activity should continue to be monitored alongside the proportion of images suitable for assessment and the number requiring referral.

## Image quality

Of the 450 captures, 21 were ungradable. The ungradable rate was 4.7 per cent. These images could not be assessed for grading purposes, so they were excluded from the results used to identify referable findings. The rate should be reviewed as part of routine quality monitoring, with attention to whether local capture practice can support consistently suitable images.

## Grading

Grading identified 127 referable results. The median lag between capture and grading was 2. This measure indicates the typical interval for processing images after capture and should be considered with the overall activity and image-quality results. Together, the measures provide a summary of service throughput, image suitability and grading outcomes at Harbour Eye Clinic for May 2026.
